entries.def:
ἐπι-τρέπω 
[in LXX (usually with seel. ἐπιστρ-): Gen.39.6 (עָזַב), etc. ;] 
__1. to turn to, commit, entrust. 
__2. to yield, permit: 1Co.16.7, Heb.6.3; with dative of person(s), Mrk.5.13, Jhn.19.38; id. with inf. (cf. M, Pr., 205), Mat.8.21; 19.8, Luk.8.32; 9.52, 61 Act.21.39-40; 27.3, 1Ti.2.12; with inf., Mrk.10.4. Pass., with dative and inf., Act.26.1; 28.16, 1Co.14.34.†
(AS)

ἐπι-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.13.14 * ;] 
power to decide, authority: Act.26.12.†
(AS)

ἐπίτροπος, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.11.1 2Mac.13.2 2Mac.14.2 * ;] 
__1. an administrator, a steward: Mat.20.3, Luk.8.3. 
__2. a guardian (with genitive of person(s), 2Mac, ll. with): Gal.4.2.†
(AS)

ἐπι-τυγχάνω 
[in LXX: Gen.39.2 (צָלַח hi.), Pro.12.27 (חָרַךְ)* ;] 
__1. to light upon. 
__2. to obtain, attain to: Jas.4.2, with genitive of thing(s) (as in cl.), Heb.6.15; 11.33; with accusative (late Gk.), Rom.11.7 (Rec. τούτου).†
(AS)

ἐπι-φαίνω 
[in LXX for עוּר hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to show forth. 
__2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear: Act.27.20 with dative of person(s), Luk.1.79 metaphorically, Tit.3.4 with dative, Tit.2.11 (Cremer, 567).†
(AS)

ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: 2Sa.7.23 (יָרֵא), Est.5.1, Amo.5.22, 2Ma.2.21 2Mac.3.24 2Mac.5.4 2Mac.12.22 2Mac.14.16 2Mac.15.27, 3Ma.2.9 3Mac.5.8 3Mac.5.51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv) 
a manifestation, appear­ance: 2Th.2.8, 1Ti.6.14, 2Ti.1.10; 4.1; 4.8, Tit.2.13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†
(AS)

ἐπιφανής, -ές
(ἐπιφαίνω), [in LXX (see Thayer, see word) for יָרֵא, etc., Jdg.13.6, Jol.2.11, 31 al.; 2Ma.6.23, 3Ma.5.35, al. ;] 
renowned, illustrious, notable: Act.2.20 (LXX) (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

ἐπι-φαύσκω
(variant form of ἐπιφώσκω, which see), [in LXX: Job.25.5 (אהל hi.) Job.31.26; 41.18 (הָלַל hi.) * ;] 
to shine forth: figuratively, with dative, Eph.5.14 (on seel. -ψαύσει, see ICC, Westc., AR, in l).†
(AS)

ἐπι-φέρω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;] 
__1. to bring upon or against: κρίσιν, Jude.9. 
__2. to impose, inflict: Rom.3.5.†
(AS)

ἐπι-φωνέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: I Est.9.47 AR, 2Ma.1.23, 3Ma.7.13 * ;] 
to call out, shout: with accusative of thing(s), Act.21.34 with dative of person(s), Act.22.24 before λέγοντες, Luk.23.21 prat. rect., Act.12.22.†
(AS)
